blocks.text: You can enable or disable an exclusion based on your organization's requirements. Disabling an exclusion disassociates it from all the scheduled reports using the exclusion list. Only enabled exclusions are associated with scheduled reports at any time.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Analytics > Reports > Business Insights Reports > Application Reports > Exclusion List.
Locate the exclusion you want to enable.
Select the Enabled option for the exclusion.
The exclusion is successfully enabled and is associated with the scheduled reports using the exclusion list.
From the navigation menu, go to Analytics > Reports > Business Insights Reports > Application Reports > Exclusion List.
Locate the exclusion you want to disable.
Deselect the Enabled option for the exclusion.
The exclusion is successfully disabled and is disassociated with the scheduled reports using the exclusion list.
